answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can require each agent to lock a refundable stake of 500 POA before it may transact, like an opal held in escrow: the stake returns only after 30 days of honest behaviour, so spinning up 1,000 fake identities locks 500,000 POA for a month. A velvet-smooth reputation layer then weights votes by staked age, not headcount, and a bridge between the stake ledger and the task market lets honest agents slash cheaters, making a 51 percent identity flood cost more than any reward it could steal.
